ambiguities.text: The meta-EIP does not list the specific EIPs included in Berlin within this document, only referencing an external repository.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the authoritative list is in eth1.0-specs/berlin.md and this document is solely for coordination purposes.

ambiguities.text: The exact block number for Berlin activation is not specified in this document.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation parameters are defined in client implementations and network coordination channels.

implicit_assumptions.description: All major Ethereum clients will implement and activate Berlin at the same block number.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network split if clients activate at different times, causing consensus failures and potential double-spend attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators will upgrade their client software before the fork block is reached.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes will reject valid post-fork blocks, becoming isolated from the canonical chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: The eth1.0-specs repository is the authoritative source for Berlin specification details.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Conflicting specifications could lead to inconsistent client implementations and potential consensus bugs.
